next.reason: 1985: "If neither the BEFORE nor AFTER phrase is specified, literal-1 or the implied operand of the CHARACTERS phrase participates"; 2023: "If neither the BEFORE nor AFTER phrase is specified or identifier-4 references a zero-length item, ... participates". Same BEFORE/AFTER restriction, but 2023 adds cases: a zero-length identifier-4 acts as no BEFORE/AFTER, and BACKWARD moves where eligibility starts and the AFTER region.
